# ProjectX — How to Import Trades from ProjectX Prop Firms Platforms into TradeZella Using the File Upload Method

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/11943188-projectx-how-to-import-trades-from-projectx-prop-firms-platforms-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

With our step-by-step guide, you can easily import your trades from any ProjectX-backed prop firm into TradeZella using the file upload method. This method works for all supported firms using the ProjectX dashboard, including:



## ✅ Supported Prop Firms:

Topstep, Alpha Futures, TickTickTrader, Bulenox, TradeDay, Blusky, Goat Futures, The Futures Desk, DayTraders, E8 Futures, Blue Guardian Futures, FuturesElite, FXIFY, Hola Prime, Top One Futures, Funding Futures, TX3 Funding



## Step 1: Export Trade Data from Your ProjectX Platform

- Log in to your ProjectX prop firm account (e.g., TickTickTrader, TradeDayX, e8markets, etc.).

Log in to your ProjectX prop firm account (e.g., TickTickTrader, TradeDayX, e8markets, etc.).

- Navigate to the “Trades” tab.

Navigate to the “Trades” tab.

- Click the “EXPORT” button in the bottom right corner of the Trades tab.

Click the “EXPORT” button in the bottom right corner of the Trades tab.

- Select the date range of the trades you want to export and click "Export."

Select the date range of the trades you want to export and click "Export."

- Save the exported file in CSV format to your desktop.

Save the exported file in CSV format to your desktop.



Tip: If the file appears blank, try widening your date range — for example, start one day before your first trade and end a few days after your last.



## Uploading the exported file into TradeZella

Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page or click the “Add Trade” button from the sidebar.

- If you’re importing into a new account, click “Add New Account”.

If you’re importing into a new account, click “Add New Account”.

- Choose ProjectX PropFirm Name* as your broker.

Choose ProjectX PropFirm Name* as your broker.

- Click Continue.

Click Continue.

- Select File Upload and click Continue

Select File Upload and click Continue

- Upload your CSV file

Upload your CSV file

- If you’re uploading to an existing account, click the “+ Add Trades” button on the account → Select File Upload → Proceed as above.

If you’re uploading to an existing account, click the “+ Add Trades” button on the account → Select File Upload → Proceed as above.



## Common Errors

- File Format: Ensure you export the file from the “Trades” tab. Files from other tabs may not be compatible with TradeZella’s importer.

File Format: Ensure you export the file from the “Trades” tab. Files from other tabs may not be compatible with TradeZella’s importer.

- Empty File: If the upload fails or shows no trades, double-check that the file contains data and isn’t blank.

Empty File: If the upload fails or shows no trades, double-check that the file contains data and isn’t blank.



By following these steps, you’ll be able to keep your journal accurate and up-to-date — no matter which ProjectX prop firm you’re using.



If you have any questions or run into issues, feel free to reach out to our support team — we’re here to help.
